AI Code Security in 2024

AI-generated code is everywhere. As GitHub Copilot and Cursor become standard developer tools, the security implications grow. Acme Code (formerly DeepCheck AI) scans AI-generated code with the same engine it uses for human-authored code.

This post covers how the Acme developer security platform handles AI-generated code today, and what's coming next for the Acme AI Trust Platform that extends to AISPM, AI BOM, agentic AI, and MCP server risk.
